latest_news.headline: Ghalibaf warns unnamed regional country: 'vital infrastructure will become target' over alleged island seizure plot
latest_news.text: Iran Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf warns enemies 'with backing of a regional country' are preparing to seize an Iranian island. Threatens: 'all vital infrastructure of that regional country will, without restriction, become the target of relentless attacks.' Country/island unnamed. New escalation vector.

latest_news.headline: White House denies Iran rejected ceasefire: 'they have not' — plan details called 'speculative'
latest_news.text: Press Secretary Leavitt pushes back hard on Iran rejection narrative: 'The White House never confirmed that plan. There are elements of truth to it but some of the stories I read were not entirely factual.' Trump 'willing to listen' and engaged in 'constructive discussions.'

latest_news.headline: Iran still reviewing US ceasefire proposal despite public rejection — senior official (Reuters)
latest_news.text: Senior Iranian official tells Reuters Iran is 'still reviewing' the US proposal. Privately, some officials were considering meeting in Islamabad. Public rejection may be posturing before talks.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan formally delivers Trump's 15-point plan to Iran — Sharif 'ready and honoured' to facilitate
latest_news.text: PM Shehbaz Sharif confirms Pakistan delivered US ceasefire proposal to Iran via diplomatic channels. Says Islamabad 'ready and honoured to facilitate meaningful and conclusive talks' if both sides agree. IAEA Islamabad talks still on track for weekend.
